name: manual_6b2d04
claim: Deployed copies of orama-system scripts under ~/.openclaw/scripts/ can silently drift stale vs the canonical repo copy in orama-system/scripts/ — diff them (ignoring CRLF) before trusting the deployed version's behavior, especially after a documented anti-pattern removal in the repo.

decisions.notes: A deployed ~/.openclaw/scripts/discover.py still contained patch_devices_yml()/patch_models_yml() — functions that write live LAN IPs into git-tracked config/devices.yml and config/models.yml. The canonical orama-system/scripts/discover.py removed these 2026-07-08 specifically because they were a doxxing/hygiene footgun (documented inline in the current source). The deployed copy was never re-synced after that fix landed. Found via diff of CRLF-stripped deployed vs canonical, since a naive diff falsely reported the entire file as different due to line-ending differences.
